AdminClient.description: A client's page: what they have going, by an ID. The name is not here.
AdminClient.title: AdminClient

AdminClientRow.description: A client as an admin sees one: a status and counts, no name and no contact.
AdminClientRow.title: AdminClientRow

AdminHealth.description:
The agent's and the system's numbers over the last `days` days, and the alerts
that fire right now (R-AL).
AdminHealth.title: AdminHealth

AdminPharmacy.description:
One pharmacy as the admin checks it: what it typed, its pin, and what the checks
found.
AdminPharmacy.title: AdminPharmacy

AdminPharmacyEdit.description: An admin corrects a pharmacy's details (SM-1). Only what is sent changes.
AdminPharmacyEdit.title: AdminPharmacyEdit

AuditRow.description:
One event of the log, as an admin reads it. **The values of the fields that
changed are never here** (only their names): they stay in the table.
AuditRow.title: AuditRow

AuditSubject.description:
The page of the console the event is about. None when there is none: a
registration whose email was never confirmed, a row deleted since, an admin's login.
AuditSubject.title: AuditSubject

AuditWho.description:
Who did it. An admin by their name and a pharmacy by its approved name; **a client
by an ID only, never a name** (BLD-D45); the assistant and the system by what they are.
AuditWho.title: AuditWho

Card.description:
A card under a message. **Its words are written by code and stored**; the model
only chose to show it (R-AG7).

- `origin = "proposal"`: made by one of the agent's tools. Its button calls
  `POST /proposals/{card_id}/execute`.
- `origin = "system"`: a template card about something that happened (reserved, picked
  up, an offer). `type` names the template and `data` holds its facts.
Card.title: Card

CardBox.description:
What a reserve, plan or "another brand" card shows of its boxes, as search shows a
box (B#5). Written by code when the card was made; the model never reads it.
CardBox.title: CardBox

ChatSummary.description: One line of the client's list of chats (D9).
ChatSummary.title: ChatSummary

ClientContact.description: Read through one audited endpoint only (A-D3).
ClientContact.title: ClientContact

ClientRequest.description: One sourcing request of a client, as their page lists it.
ClientRequest.title: ClientRequest

ClientReservation.description: One reservation of a client, as their page lists it.
ClientReservation.title: ClientReservation

ConfirmReport.description:
[Real problem]. The console sends nothing with it: a confirmed report is a
regression case, filed under "other" unless a category is given.
ConfirmReport.title: ConfirmReport

ContestedReservation.description: An expired reservation the client says they picked up (R-N3).
ContestedReservation.title: ContestedReservation

DeleteAccount.description: A client deletes their own account (R-AU10): their password, typed again.
DeleteAccount.title: DeleteAccount

DemoClock.description: The app's own time (R-DEMO). Outside demo mode it is the real time, always.
DemoClock.title: DemoClock

EarlyReleaseAsk.description:
"A client needs 2 packs today. You hold 5 that aren't listed yet. Release them?"
Nothing here says who the client is (R-E8).
EarlyReleaseAsk.title: EarlyReleaseAsk

EscalationNote.description: A later escalation of the same client, added to the open one (SM-9).
EscalationNote.title: EscalationNote

HomePlace.description: The client's own saved place, as they put it (rounded to about 100 m).
HomePlace.title: HomePlace

Listing.description: One visible box a client can reserve (docs/04 SM-3).
Listing.title: Listing

LocationIn.description:
Where the client is: a shared or picked point, or a district. Stored rounded, and
never sent to the AI (R-S2).
LocationIn.title: LocationIn

LoggedIn.description: Who logged in, and the token the website sends from now on (docs/06 §2.1).
LoggedIn.title: LoggedIn

MedicineGroup.description: One medicine of a search by name: a catalog product under its own name.
MedicineGroup.title: MedicineGroup

Message.description: A plain sentence, for the answers that say nothing else.
Message.title: Message

MessagesPage.description: What the page asks for every few seconds while it is open (API-D7).
MessagesPage.title: MessagesPage

NoMatch.description: Boxes exist, but none lasts the client's days or can be had on their day (R-F4).
NoMatch.title: NoMatch

Offer.description:
Stock held for the client for two hours: from new stock that matched their need,
or released by a pharmacy the agent asked. A tap accepts it (O7, O8).
Offer.title: Offer

OpeningRange.description:
One opening range of a weekday, Monday = 0: `{weekday: 0, open: "08:00",
close: "13:00"}`. A day has up to two; a day with none is closed. `close` may be
"24:00".
OpeningRange.title: OpeningRange

PharmacyCard.description: What a client sees about a pharmacy.
PharmacyCard.title: PharmacyCard

PharmacyDetails.description:
What a pharmacy says about itself (PS-1). The exact shape of each field is checked
by the rules, which answer with the field's name and a sentence.
PharmacyDetails.title: PharmacyDetails

Pin.description:
Where a pharmacy is: public, like its address. It is what [Directions] opens and
what the map shows. (A **client's** location is what never leaves the server.)
Pin.title: Pin

Place.description: A town or a neighbourhood of our own list of places (docs/04 R-S2).
Place.title: Place

ProfileChange.description:
Only what is sent changes. The three name parts are sent together; so are the
district and the town, because a town belongs to its district.
ProfileChange.title: ProfileChange

PublicConfig.description: What the website needs before anyone logs in. No secret, no stock.
PublicConfig.title: PublicConfig

RegistrationChange.description:
A pharmacy that waits for approval, or was rejected, corrects what it typed
(PS-2). Only what is sent changes.
RegistrationChange.title: RegistrationChange

RegressionCases.description:
Confirmed reports added to the regression set, as the team copies them into the
repo (docs/08 §5).
RegressionCases.title: RegressionCases

ReportAnswer.description: The client's thumbs-down on a reply.
ReportAnswer.title: ReportAnswer

ReportedRun.description: The agent turn that wrote the reply.
ReportedRun.title: ReportedRun

ResetPassword.description: The form of a "set a new password" link: the link's token and the new password.
ResetPassword.title: ResetPassword

SearchByName.description:
A search by a typed name: every medicine it stands for, with its boxes in stock.
A POST for the same reason as `SearchListings`: the location travels in the body.
SearchByName.title: SearchByName

SearchListings.description:
A search. **It is a POST so that the client's location travels in the body**, never
in an address that a browser's history or a server's log keeps.
SearchListings.title: SearchListings

Searched.description: A name the client searched, to keep in their list of last searches.
Searched.title: Searched

Searches.description: The client's last searches, the newest first.
Searches.title: Searches

SelectableItem.description: One checkbox of a [Reserve these] card (R-RQ6).
SelectableItem.title: SelectableItem

SettingsChange.description:
What an approved pharmacy changes by itself (PS-10): its hours, its pickup time,
its phone number, its address and its pin. Its name and its licence are changed by
DawaLink's team.
SettingsChange.title: SettingsChange

StockItemChange.description:
Only what is sent changes. `price_override_lbp: null` goes back to the system's
price.
StockItemChange.title: StockItemChange

StockUpload.description: A stock file that was read. Nothing changes until it is applied (SM-4).
StockUpload.title: StockUpload

ThreadMessage.description: One message of the conversation, as it is stored: without personal details.
ThreadMessage.title: ThreadMessage

Travel.description: How far a pharmacy is from the client. Computed by code; never a coordinate.
Travel.title: Travel

Waiting.description: What DawaLink is doing for a medicine that isn't secured yet.
Waiting.title: Waiting

WithReason.description: An admin's action and why. An empty reason is `REASON_REQUIRED`.
WithReason.title: WithReason

post.description:
`warn` records that the account's owner was warned; `suspend` suspends the
account, with everything a suspension does.

get.description: The newest first. `total`: the reports the choice matches.

The confirmed reports that were added to the regression set (A-D6): the reply, the
messages before it and the agent turn, without personal details. Audited.

post.description:
[Real problem]: the report is confirmed and joins the regression cases the
export gives (A-D6). A category may be sent; the console sends none.
[Not a problem].

get.description:
Who changed what, newest first. Read-only: nothing can change or delete an event.
`action=pharmacy.` gives every action of that kind, `kind` one family of the "Kind"
filter. `cursor` is the last ID seen; `offset` skips that many events of what is left
(numbered pages send only `offset`). `total`: the events the choices match, wherever
the page is. **A changed field is named, never its value.**

Every product of the Ministry's list as imported, the controlled ones included.
Nothing here changes the catalog: the import script and the team's files do.
`total`: the products the text matches.

Clients as statuses and counts: **no name, no email, no phone**. `ref` finds the
client of an order number or a request number. `having` keeps the clients with a
reservation going, who picked an order up, with an open request, or who need a look
(a contested no-show or an open flag). `total`: the clients the choices match.

One client by their ID: the counts, their last reservations and requests with
how each ended, what they contest, and the flags about them. **Still no name:** that
is the audited `/contact` below.

The client's name, email and phone, for support. **Each view is written to the
audit log**, and an admin gets 30 an hour (N-47): past that, `RATE_LIMITED`.

post.description:
Every login of the client ends at once; their open requests and watches end, and
their open reservations and offers are cancelled (SM-2).

Moves the app's time forward, to show time-based behavior live: an offer expiring,
the one-hour-left check, a no-show. **Demo mode only**, and every move is audited
(R-DEMO). Logins are counted in real time, so nobody is logged out by it.

get.description:
Without `state`: every escalation that is not resolved, emergency claims first,
then the cases that wait for the team (never answered, asked again, or the client
wrote since the team's reply), then the answered ones; inside each, the one whose
newest ask is the oldest first. `RESOLVED`: the newest closed first. `total`: the
cases the choice matches.

The escalation with the conversation it came from, as stored: personal details
were removed before it was written (A-D4, INV-10).

post.description:
The client reads the reply in their conversation, signed "DawaLink team", and is
notified (CN-14). It is stored as typed (a person may have to give a phone number),
and cleaned where the model or an export reads it. A first reply marks the
escalation as being handled. **It changes no order and no priority** (R-PRI4).
[Close this case]. A note of what was done may go with it; none is asked for.

get.description:
The agent's numbers (turns, latency, errors, cost, guards), what it achieved
(requests fulfilled, re-plans, early release), the marketplace's, the system's, and
the alerts that fire now (R-AL). Counted from our own tables: no personal data.
What waits for an admin (AS-2).

Pharmacies whose email is confirmed. `status=PENDING` is the approval queue, the
one that has waited longest first. `total`: the pharmacies the choices match.

patch.description:
An admin corrects a name, a licence, a phone, an address or the pin (SM-1). Only
what is sent is checked and changed; the audit event names the fields, not the values.

post.description:
PENDING → APPROVED (SM-1). `version` is the one read with the details: if the
pharmacy corrected them since, the answer is `CHANGED_SINCE` and nothing changes.

The admin looked at the map: the pin is on the address. For a pharmacy that moved
by itself; a wrong pin is corrected with `PATCH` instead.
SUSPENDED → APPROVED: its listings are visible again (SM-1).
PENDING → REJECTED. The pharmacy reads the reason, and may correct and resubmit.
Still PENDING: the pharmacy reads what is missing (`reason`) and corrects it.

APPROVED → SUSPENDED: its listings are hidden, the offers on its boxes are
cancelled and its open asks withdrawn. Reservations already made are kept (SM-1).

The admin accepts a contest: the expired reservation no longer counts as a
no-show, and a pause it caused is lifted if it no longer applies (R-N3). The
reservation itself is not changed.

A wrong login is counted twice before we answer: for its account (R-AU2, five and
it is locked), and for the network address it came from (N-52). An account's lock
stops guessing one account; the address's limit stops one visitor from trying a few
passwords on every account, each of which costs the server a password hash.

Always the same answer, whatever the email (R-AU9, R-AU7): nobody can find out
here who uses DawaLink. A link goes only to an account that could log in today.

Always "check your email", whether or not the address already has an account
(R-AU7): nobody can find out here who uses DawaLink.

A pharmacy registers itself and its one account (PS-1). Like a client's sign-up
it always answers "check your email" (R-AU7); the registration reaches DawaLink's
team once the email is confirmed. A licence or a phone number that another pharmacy
has is refused.

The link of the confirmation email. It confirms the address and logs nobody in
(R-AU4): every earlier session of the account has ended, and the person logs in with
their password.

get.description:
Medicines whose name or ingredient looks like `q`. Spelling mistakes are
tolerated, and **controlled medicines are never among them** (R-C6).
The client's one chat, created the first time they open the assistant (D9).

The client's own chats, the newest first: the one they write in now and the
earlier ones, which are kept 30 days (D9). Reading one is `GET …/messages`.

post.description: Starts a fresh chat. The old one is archived, and kept 30 days (R-RET).

put.description:
Where the agent's tools count travel times from in this chat. The point is rounded
before it is stored, and it is never part of what the AI reads (INV-24).

get.description:
The messages after `after_seq`, oldest first. With `after_seq=0`, the newest ones.

This is what an open chat or request page asks for every few seconds (API-D7).

post.description:
A client's message.

- **In the chat** the answer comes back at once as a stream of events (`200`,
  `text/event-stream`): progress lines, then the complete, checked reply.
- **In a request's thread** the answer is `202`: the worker runs the agent's turn,
  and the page sees the reply by polling.
- **In a conversation DawaLink's team has** (it replied to the client's case and has
  not closed it, `with_team`): the message is kept for the team and the answer is
  `202` with `with_team: true`, at once. No agent turn runs and none is coming; the
  checks that only matter for the model (the assistant's availability, the day's
  token budget, a turn already running) don't refuse it. The limits on messages, a
  suspended account and an earlier chat are checked as always.

200.description: In a chat: the answer, as a stream of events.

post.description:
The thumbs-down under a reply of the assistant, once per reply (SM-10). A copy of
the reply and of the messages before it is kept for DawaLink's team; the client's
comment is stored without personal details, like a message.

get.description:
Always 200 while the process runs.

The load balancer only needs to know the process is alive. If this answered 503 when the
database is down, healthy API tasks would be killed instead of answering "try again" (FX-10).

post.description:
The visible boxes of one medicine, **and only of that medicine**: search never
shows another brand (R-S4).

With `days_of_use`, boxes that don't last are left out. With `pickup_day`, only
pharmacies that accept that day are shown, and the fit is counted from it.

Everything in stock for a typed name, grouped by medicine (CS-6).

"panadol" answers with every Panadol a pharmacy lists, each under its own name,
strength and form; a misspelled name answers with the closest one and says so.
**Still only what was typed** (R-S4): a medicine is here because its name, or what it
contains, matches the words, never because it could replace another one.

One box and its pharmacy, for their own page (CS-7). A box that stopped being
visible answers `NOT_FOUND`.

get.description:
The place the caller saved, so their own map can show it. It is sent to nobody
else, and never in an address.

put.description:
Saves or moves the caller's home place (CS-13). Rounded before it is stored; a new
place can start a paid routing call, so it counts for the hourly limit (N-47).

patch.description: Only what was sent changes (CS-13). An empty phone removes it.

delete.description: [Clear]: the caller's whole list is deleted.

get.description: The caller's last searches, the newest first (CS-6). Nobody else reads them.

post.description:
Keeps a name the client searched. The page sends it when a search led somewhere (a
result was opened, or Enter was pressed), not for every letter typed. A name that is
not a medicine's name in shape is quietly left out.

Marks the caller's own notifications as read. An ID that isn't theirs changes
nothing: the numbers follow each other, so they must not be a way in.

get.description: The offers waiting for the client's answer, the one that ends soonest first.

post.description:
The offer becomes a reservation; the need's other offers are withdrawn at once
(O9). An offer is accepted once: a second tap answers with the reservation the first
one made, as it is (its pickup day included), and reserves nothing more.
"No thanks": the box goes to the next client who waits for it (O10).

get.description:
"A client needs this today, and you hold it privately. Release it?" The need is
described without anything about the client (R-E8).

post.description:
The pharmacy releases the box: the client gets an offer for two hours. If the need
was met in the meantime, nothing is reserved and the pharmacy is thanked (R-E6).

get.description:
The pharmacy's boxes, soonest expiry first; `sort=medicine` puts the boxes of one
medicine side by side (one per batch and expiry). `zone=NEAR_EXPIRY` is its
listings. `total` counts the boxes these choices keep, on every page.

post.description:
One box typed by hand. The same medicine, batch and expiry twice is refused
(`ITEM_EXISTS`): the pharmacy corrects the quantity of the one it has.

patch.description:
A quantity corrected after a sale in the shop, the pharmacy's own price, a pause,
or [List now]. Reserved packs are never taken away here (R-U3).

get.description: The file to fill in: five columns, two example rows.

post.description:
Reads a stock file and says what applying it would change. **Nothing changes
yet**, and the file itself is never kept (SM-4). A new file replaces the one that was
waiting.

get.description:
The file that waits for [Apply] or [Discard]: the screen finds it again after a
reload.

post.description: [Apply]: the file becomes the pharmacy's stock, all rows or none (R-U1 to R-U4).

get.description: The pharmacy's own details, in any status (a pending one sees it is pending).

patch.description:
An approved pharmacy changes its opening hours, its pickup time, its phone number,
its address or its pin (PS-10). Reservations already made keep the deadline they were
given (R-T5). A new address or pin counts at once; an admin looks at the pin again.

While it waits, or after a rejection, the pharmacy corrects what it typed (PS-2).
Only what is sent changes; everything is checked again as at registration.

post.description: After a rejection: back in the queue of DawaLink's team (SM-1).

get.description:
The pharmacy's reservations. With `q`, the one with that order number, however it
was typed ("r7k3q2f" finds R-7K3Q2F), whatever its state: the counter needs to see
"already picked up" too. `total` counts the reservations of the view, on every page.

post.description:
Some or all of the packs aren't there (O3). Never a penalty for the client: they
are told, and the agent looks elsewhere.

The client showed the order number and took the box (O2). There is no late
pickup: after the deadline the box is back in stock (INV-7).

get.description:
The towns and neighbourhoods of a district, from our own list of places: what a
client chooses a home town from. Public, like the list of districts.

Only the places whose name is written in Latin letters: the map gives some villages a
name in Arabic script only, and one list in two alphabets reads as a mistake (the
owner, 2026-11-18). Those places can still be named to the assistant.

post.description:
The client tapped an agent card. Everything is checked again as if it were new
(R-AG7): the card holds no authority, only what to try.

A card works once, so a second tap of the same card answers `PROPOSAL_USED`.

get.description:
The client's requests: the open ones (2 at most, R-RQ2), or the closed ones, the
newest first.

post.description: The client stops the search. What is already reserved stays reserved (R-RQ9).

get.description:
`active`: what is reserved now, the soonest pickup first. `history`: the rest,
the newest first. `total` counts the reservations of the view, on every page.

post.description:
[Reserve] on the search page: the box is the client's at once (O1).

The same `Idempotency-Key` sent twice returns the same reservation: a double tap or a
network retry never reserves two boxes. `source` is "search", so the agent is never
told (R-AG5).
The client cancels before the deadline. It is never a penalty (O5, R-N2).

[I picked it up] on an expired reservation: the pharmacy forgot to press
[Picked up] (R-N3). Once per missed trip, while it still counts: the boxes of a plan
card are contested together. A person from DawaLink looks at it: nothing changes
until they do.

get.description:
The client's own watches, the newest first. `live`: still waiting or holding an
offer.

post.description:
[Notify me]: DawaLink watches for this medicine for 6 hours and offers the first
box that appears, to whoever asked first (R-W1, R-PRI). Only during request hours.

Asking twice for the same medicine answers `WATCH_EXISTS` with the watch's ID, so a
repeated tap creates nothing: this endpoint needs no idempotency key.
[Stop watching]. An offer the watch held goes to the next client who waits.
